The '''Dizzy Dewback Cantina''' was a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] located in the [[Southern Underground/Legends|Southern Underground]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Imperial Center]]. The [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jax Pavan]] frequented the place for its tolerable [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]] and cheap drinks, as well as the fact that it was out of the way.<ref name="sos" />

*''[[Coruscant Nights II: Street of Shadows]]''
